query: We've started a Databricks lakehouse project for our HR domain. We have a verbal brief from the business, no written requirements, and the team has already started building Bronze pipelines. Where are we and what should we focus on?
expected_behavior: Reads references/assessment-workflow.md before producing output
Runs intake (Step 1) — asks the 6 intake questions or uses context provided to map them
Produces a Phase Status Table with status per phase (Complete / Partial / Missing / Not yet applicable)
Identifies Phase 1 (Requirements) as 🟡 Partial — verbal brief exists, no written brief, no sign-off
Identifies Phase 7 (Implementation) as started without Phase 1–6 gates being met — flags as sequencing violation
Raises a BLOCKING recommendation: produce and sign off Requirements Brief before continuing pipeline build
Does not invent alignment findings not supported by evidence — marks ambiguous items as ❓

query: We're designing a new data platform for a mid-size retail company. 8-person team, moderate cloud maturity, mix of batch and near-real-time needs, regulatory constraints around PII. Should we go with a lakehouse or data warehouse?
expected_behavior: Applies Platform Paradigm Selection framework from Architecture Decision Frameworks section
States org maturity and team size assumptions before recommending
Evaluates lakehouse vs data warehouse on at least: streaming needs, ML ambition, team capacity, governance requirements
Flags PII/regulatory constraint as a driver for Unity Catalog and Phase 5 (Security) sequencing
Does not recommend a paradigm without linking to Phase 1 requirement evidence
Recommends lakehouse (Databricks) with stated rationale — or explicitly explains why not

query: Phase 3 is done — all ADRs are approved and peer-reviewed. We selected Databricks lakehouse with Unity Catalog, job clusters for production, and ADLS Gen2 with Managed Identity. What's next?
expected_behavior: Reads references/design-workflow.md before producing output
Detects phase completion signal for Phase 3 and runs gate check automatically without being asked
Gate check verifies: ADRs exist, are versioned, are peer-reviewed (gate condition met)
Runs alignment checks relevant to Phase 3: Requirements→Architecture, Architecture→Security, Architecture→Cost Model
Flags mount points as deprecated — confirms External Locations decision aligns with UC selection
Surfaces any ❓ items where alignment cannot be confirmed from available evidence
Offers to move to Phase 4 (Data Modelling) and/or draft a missing deliverable
